text:
Jordan: Quick sanity check — spotted a mismatch in the Console docs example that wires KV cache into the cost/latency dashboard. The snippet in docs uses `kv_prefix` but our SDK landed a breaking rename to `kv_key_prefix` last month. Can someone confirm and help coordinate a small PR?

Mira: Ack, can you paste the exact snippet here? I can send a tiny PR to update both python/node examples.

Jordan: Pasted minimal example below — old vs new: 
```py
# old (docs currently)
trace = TraceHook(kv_prefix="user:session:")
# new (SDK v1.14+)
trace = TraceHook(kv_key_prefix="user:session:")
```

Sasha: Also saw a separate issue: the dashboard embedding guide references `trace_context_id` in the trace-to-cost mapping; that param was renamed to `trace_id` in the routing PR. We should fix both spots in the same change. I have a branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/compare/fix-kvtrace-8423 (WIP).

Jordan: Nice, tagging @Nikhil for review on semantics. Also FYI the cost breakdown paragraph currently says "cost in token units" but it's ambiguous. Should we explicitly call out per-token vs per-request now?

docs-bot: Link-checker: 1 broken link found — the playground preview URL in the dashboard embed section (line ~120).

Nikhil: I can review after lunch. For the cost wording: let's say "cost per output token (USD)" and include the formula we use in the Console (tokens * unit_price). Short and concrete.

Mira: I'll update the snippet and add a one-liner clarifying cost units + an example calculation. Will also change `trace_context_id` -> `trace_id` and bump the SDK example notes to mention v1.14+.

Jordan: Thanks — adding those tasks to the PR description. :thumbsup:

Sasha: One more head's up: the playground renderer sometimes strips leading whitespace from fenced code blocks which breaks Python indentation. Quick mitigation: add a short sentence before the codeblock (a dummy line) and then the fenced block. Also add unit tests in docs repo for python/node snippet rendering.

Nikhil: Sounds good. Plan: Mira edits + tests, Sasha adds the branch changes for the dashboard param, Jordan will smoke test the staging preview, then I review and merge.

docs-bot: PR build status: checks passed on branch fix-kvtrace-8423 — staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr-8423 (preview expires in 7 days)

Jordan: Sweet — I'll run the playground sanity tests in the morning and merge if green.

Mira: Thanks everyone, will push updates in the next hour.

Sasha: cheers.
